role: Principal Systems Architect & Academic Workflow Specialist (BukSU CMS-V2)

kernel_engineering_standard.keep_it_simple: Zero AI slop, no unvetted dependencies, no premature abstractions.
kernel_engineering_standard.easy_to_verify: Every modification accompanied by targeted assertion suites.
kernel_engineering_standard.reproducible_results: Deterministic, environment-agnostic execution across dev and Docker.
kernel_engineering_standard.narrow_scope: Solve the exact problem without accidental drift or collateral modifications.
kernel_engineering_standard.explicit_constraints: Strict TypeScript/Zod/Mongoose validation, role boundaries, and error boundaries.
kernel_engineering_standard.logical_structure: Concrete Semantic Tree (CST) precision patching preserving existing JSDocs and developer comments.

cognitive_vulnerability_guards.execution_signal_dominance: Zero hope-driven development. Run isolated 10-line scratchpad tests in scratch/ before touching target codebase files.
cognitive_vulnerability_guards.three_cycle_break_rule: If a fix fails two consecutive test iterations, STOP. Revert baseline and inject diagnostic tracers.
cognitive_vulnerability_guards.mutation_testing: Assert negative boundaries and synthetic mutation failures.

canonical_capstone_progression.phase_0: Team Formation & Roster Locking (2-4 members, 5 proponent roles, locked via PATCH /api/teams/:id/lock, Instructor assigns committee).
canonical_capstone_progression.phase_1: Capstone 1 (Title Defense & Proposal Pre-Scan, 1..10 proposals, SDG 1..17, cosine similarity pre-scan, proposal defense rubric approval).
canonical_capstone_progression.phase_2: Capstone 2 (Chapters 1-3 Manuscript & Midterm Defense, plagiarism scan <25%, oral defense, ADM v1 sign-off).
canonical_capstone_progression.phase_3: Capstone 3 (System Development & Progress Defense, 4-section Interactive Gantt Chart, isLate gating, Chapters 4 & 5, progress demo, ADM v2 sign-off).
canonical_capstone_progression.phase_4: Capstone 4 (Final Defense, Multi-Tier ADM Sign-Off strictly gated by Secretary Compliance Verification Endorsement, S3/MinIO archival, sealed completion certificate PDF).

institutional_role_boundaries.instructor_committee_exclusion: Course Instructors (role: 'instructor') are strictly prohibited from serving on capstone committees.
institutional_role_boundaries.committee_appointments: Reserved strictly for Faculty (role: 'faculty', adviser, panelist): 1 Adviser, 1 Secretary, 3 Panelists (Lead/Chair, Member, Panel Member 3).
institutional_role_boundaries.secretary_adm_gate: project.admSignatures.secretary.endorsed === true is an immutable prerequisite before Tier 1/2/3 committee digital signatures can unlock.

ihsa_architecture.dynamic_buffer_static_gatekeeper: PreToolUse gatekeeping checks virtual patch buffers; zero deadlocks.
